implementation.accessibility: A declared two-byte-intermediate toy compares a materialized attention baseline with exact tiled attention. Scores and probabilities each incur one n-squared-element write and read in the baseline. Tiling avoids those global intermediates but still moves inputs, weights as applicable, and final output and retains dense quadratic arithmetic. All labels use at least 12 viewBox units in a 360-unit-wide composition. Meaning is also encoded by positions, words, line styles, and numbers, not color alone.
